# What you can build

Worked examples, grouped by task. Recipes are short and solve one task; most
run on real market data committed with the docs: six hours of Deribit BTC and
ETH perpetual trades, daily Binance bars of 20 coins from 2022 to 2026, and the
BTC perpetual's funding rates. Notebooks tour one area in depth. Every example
runs when the docs build. The [gallery](gallery.rst) shows a plot for every
function.

(area-getting-started)=
## Getting started

The first steps: one strategy from prices to a p-value, the screamer equivalents of common pandas and TA-Lib calls, and how one operator handles scalars, arrays, live streams, and missing values.

Functions: [`RollingMean`](functions_rolling/RollingMean.md), [`BacktestPriceTarget`](functions_fin/BacktestPriceTarget.md), [`backtest_report`](functions_fin/backtest_report.md).

Guides: [Using screamer](usage.md), [Polymorphic API](polymorphic_api.md), [NaN and warmup](nan_and_warmup.md).

(area-indicators-and-filters)=
## Indicators and filters

Rolling statistics and technical indicators on arrays or DataFrame columns, from moving averages to RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and ATR. For smoother signals with less lag, use the low-lag smoothers, Butterworth filters, a Kalman filter, and Ehlers' cycle tools that measure the dominant cycle and adapt to it.

Functions: [`RollingRSI`](functions_rolling/RollingRSI.md), [`MACD`](functions_rolling/MACD.md), [`BollingerBands`](functions_rolling/BollingerBands.md), [`SuperSmoother`](functions_signal/SuperSmoother.md), [`KalmanFilter`](functions_signal/KalmanFilter.md), [`DominantCycle`](functions_signal/DominantCycle.md), [all indicators](by_group/indicators.rst).

(area-is-it-luck)=
## Is it luck?

Tests of whether a backtest result could have come from luck: randomly timed copies of the strategy, the whole search rerun on permuted markets, and corrections for the number of settings tried.

Functions: [`position_test`](functions_fin/position_test.md), [`strategy_test`](functions_fin/strategy_test.md), [`deflated_sharpe`](functions_fin/deflated_sharpe.md), [`walk_forward`](functions_fin/walk_forward.md).

Guides: [Which test when](backtesting_best_practices.md#luck), in the backtesting best practices.

(area-portfolios-and-pairs)=
## Portfolios and pairs

Rank assets against each other, turn scores into weights, and backtest the book from one account with rebalancing, exposure limits, and per-asset costs. Pairs trading with a Kalman hedge ratio, a cointegration test, and entry and exit bands.

Functions: [`CrossRank`](functions_cross/CrossRank.md), [`CrossNormalize`](functions_cross/CrossNormalize.md), [`BacktestPortfolioOHLCTarget`](functions_fin/BacktestPortfolioOHLCTarget.md), [`KalmanRegression`](functions_fin/KalmanRegression.md), [`BandSignal`](functions_signal/BandSignal.md).

Guides: [Portfolios and pairs](portfolio_backtesting.md).

(area-labels-and-classification)=
## Labels and classification

Turn future prices into class labels: the direction of the next move, a move beyond a threshold in volatility units, or the first of an upper, lower, or time barrier to be touched. Train a classifier on them, or use the labels to filter the trades of an existing rule.

Functions: [`TripleBarrier`](functions_fin/TripleBarrier.md), [`TripleBarrierOHLC`](functions_fin/TripleBarrierOHLC.md), [`forecast_pairs`](functions_supervised/forecast_pairs.md).

Guides: [Labels and training sets](labels.md).
